title: Kaizen declarative axis
description: Validates skills/workflow/domain/axes/<name>.yaml — declarative coverage-axis spec dispatched by kaizen-axis-runner. One axis YAML = one scan-spec (grep | ast-rule | file-coverage) + a verdict rule. The loader subsumes simple standalone-Python axes per blueprint /tmp/axis-runner.blueprint.json item-02.

name.description: Axis identifier (kebab-case). Surfaces in the envelope, in `list_axes()`, and in the filename.

description.description: One-sentence human summary of what this axis checks.

pattern.description: Python `re` regex pattern matched against each line.

glob.description: Path glob (Path.rglob-style) resolved relative to the scan root.
Path glob — typically `**/*.py` for AST rules.

params.description: Rule-specific parameters passed through to the rule function.

expected_glob.description: Glob enumerating files that SHOULD have a matching counterpart (e.g. `scripts/quality/*.py`).

actual_glob.description: Glob enumerating the actual counterparts (e.g. `tests/test_*.py`). The match heuristic is stem-based: `name.py` ↔ `test_name.py`.

yellow_max.description: Findings count ≤ this → verdict=yellow; above → red. MUST be ≥ green_max.
